newsitem.title: USA: Nabors Industries buys Samson Rig.
newsitem.headline: Nabors Industries buys Samson Rig.

text.p: Nabors Industries Inc said on Friday it has completed the previously announced acquisition of Samson Rig Company and Rig Properties Inc. from a subsidiary of Samson Investment Co for $85 million in cash.

The property of the acquired companies consists of 25 stacked diesel electric rigs, the bulk of which are capable of drilling to depths of greater than 15,000 feet, and a large complement of component equipment, Nabors said.
Samson Investment is a large privately-owned business enterprise with exploration and production offices located in Tulsa, Calgary, Venezuela and Russia, Nabors said.
Nabors actively markets over 370 land drilling and 75 land well servicing rigs, it said.
